data.action: 俯身扫弦，主音吉他狂飙
data.description: 【陈 · 音律联觉舞台】音律联觉音乐会主舞台，激光与干冰烟雾中，主音吉他手陈怀抱赤红电吉他俯身扫弦，赤龙图腾在追光灯下灼灼发亮——「今晚的规矩只有一条——把音量开到最大！」
data.lighting: stage spotlight and laser beams through dry-ice haze
data.promptProse: Leaning over her red electric guitar, Ch'en sweeps the strings in her crimson-and-black asymmetric rocker jacket. The low-angle nighttime stage view places the guitar body forward, with dry-ice haze hanging between her and the rear rigging. Spotlights pick out the red-dragon motif and metal strings; colored laser beams cross the haze behind her, while her boots remain anchored at the stage edge.
data.title: 陈 · 音律联觉舞台
